calculation.description: For each tradable benchmark instrument, fade its completed seven-session return relative to the same-date cross-sectional median, scaled by trailing 20-session daily return volatility. Signals use only completed bars. Dates with fewer than eight valid instruments are excluded from cross-sectional normalization. Higher values indicate stronger expected next-day reversal.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC is positive in 2020-2022 (0.03636; ICIR 0.10703), weaker and below the ICIR gate in 2023-2024 (0.01980; 0.06169), and positive again in 2025-2026 (0.03289; 0.10512). Predictive decay is rapid and primarily next-day.
